events.text: The construction of the new werk was started.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The construction of the new werk was started in 1300 .

events.subject: self
events.quote: It was completed after ten years in 1310 .

events.text: The fire in the 1360s destroyed most of the wooden elements.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The fire in the 1360s destroyed most of the wooden elements

events.text: The original lead roof was replaced by copper.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The original roof was made of lead , and was replaced by copper in 1474 .

events.text: The copper roof was replaced by a tiled roof.
events.subject: self
events.quote: This was again replaced in 1558 by a tiled roof

events.text: The copper was used for military purposes.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The copper was then used for military purposes in 1916

events.text: The tower served as the northernmost measuring point for the triangulation of the Kingdom of Hannover by Carl Friedrich Gauss.
events.subject: self
events.object: triangulation of the Kingdom of Hannover
events.quote: The tower served as the northernmost measuring point for the triangulation of the Kingdom of Hannover by Carl Friedrich Gauss in July 1825 .

events.text: The tower is protected under cultural heritage management.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The tower is protected under cultural heritage management since 1924

events.text: The surrounding dwelling hill is protected.
events.subject: self
events.quote: and the surrounding dwelling hill since 1971 .
